title: HiRID-ICU-Benchmark — A Comprehensive Machine Learning Benchmark on High-resolution ICU Data
reasoning: The paper is a technical work that introduces a new benchmark for machine learning models on high-resolution clinical time-series data from Intensive Care Units (ICUs). The focus is entirely on data preprocessing, task definition, and model performance evaluation for clinical prediction tasks. There is no component related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
